description: This file defines the OrdersController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. The controller manages delivery order operations such as creation, retrieval, listing by user, and updating status. It interacts with the IOrderService and IUserService for business logic.

classes.name: OrdersController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling delivery orders; provides API endpoints for creating, retrieving, listing, and updating orders.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new delivery order. Validates input, checks user existence, and calls the order service to create the order, returning the created order.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve an order by its ID. Returns order details if found, or a not found response.

methods.name: ListByUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all orders associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the status of an existing order. Validates input and updates the order status via the service.
